source.derivation: unique scenario/variant/arm cells of the frozen fixture manifest

repositoryBaselineRule: every live artifact binds the repository commit it was produced from, and a corpus mixing commits is refused

sampling.note: one sampling configuration for every role; no role may differ

stochasticityDeclaration: the production Responses request contract owns no seed field, so residual provider stochasticity is an experimental variable controlled by the exact model snapshot, exact request inputs, temperature/top_p, 3 repetitions and balanced ordering — determinism is not claimed

balance.achievedProperty: every arm occupies a DIFFERENT ordinal position in each repetition; with 3 repetitions and 5 arms each arm reaches 3 of the 5 positions, which is the maximum achievable
balance.residualImbalance: each arm misses 2 of the 5 ordinal positions; no arm is first or last more than once

productFailureRule: a failed product trial remains data and is never discarded as a bad run
resultFreezing: trial records are written once and never rewritten; a re-run produces a new trialId

A.basis: worker economic ceiling (no governed planner on this path)

A2a.basis: worker economic ceiling (no governed planner on this path)

A2b.basis: worker economic ceiling (no governed planner on this path)

B.basis: planner ceiling 1 + 3 leaf Runs x worker ceiling 3

C.basis: planner ceiling 1 + 3 leaf Runs x worker ceiling 3

economics.note: a HARD GLOBAL CAP. It may only tighten existing per-role and per-trial economic authority and may never widen a Run's limit. It is not spending authorization; execution requires explicit approval.
